title: IS12:: variables.c (3.1)

lines.explanation: Here two integer variables are defined. One is named count, another - half_count. Variable names have to start with a letter and may include any letters and digits. Underscore '_' is an eligible letter.
Variable count gets value 44 as a result of the assignment operation
Variable half_count gets value 22 as a result of the assignment operation
Variable count gets value 99 as a result of the assignment operation. Nothing happened with half_count. It is still store value 22 - the last that was assigmed
Variable half_count gets value 49 as a result of the assignment operation. Since the value of count is 99 at this point, the result of integer division count / 2 is 49
Variable count gets value 100 as a result of the assignment operation. Nothing happened with half_count. It is still store value 49 - the last that was assigmed.
